name: markdown-prompt
description: Renders prompt code blocks in VSCode's markdown preview as AI prompts to copy or open in Claude, ChatGPT and other services, collapsed by default, in the editor's theme
author: Drake Costa <drake@saeris.io> (https://saeris.gg)

bumpy.buildCommand: vp pack && vp exec postcss src/prompt.css --output dist/prompt.css && vp exec vsce package --no-dependencies
